@@U02205@@
Noble hearts are never worsted, Forge onward to a grand new birth!

@@U02206@@
(A tremendous clangor heralds the approach of the sun.)

@@U02208@@
Harken! Hark! The storm of hours! Pealing out to spirit ears, Rejoice! Another day is ours! Rejoice! Another dawn appears! Granite gates are crashing, crashing, 福玻斯’s car wheels rattling, clashing— What clangor announces the rising sun! Drums and trumpets pealing clear, Dazzling eye and stunning ear! Away! Our elfin reign is done. Into flowery chalice creep, Rest in quiet, deep in sleep, Or under rock, or under cleft; If you hear it, you are deaf.

@@U02210@@
Life’s pulses beat in me now with fresh vitality, ready to greet the dawn’s ethereal day. Earth, great earth, you were loyal to me in the night, and now you, too, revived anew, already infuse me with a grand desire, rousing in me a powerful resolve: to strive and ever to strive to the pinnacle of Being. The world is unlocked to view in the dawn’s first dim light; the woods are alive and ring with a thousand voices; and valleys high and low are shrouded in mist ull the clear light of heaven descends to their depths. And from the misty haze boughs and branches waken
translation:
@@U02205@@
高尚之心永不磨灭，砥砺前行，走向辉煌新生！

@@U02206@@
（一声巨大的铿锵声预示着太阳即将来临。）

@@U02208@@
哈肯！听着！几个小时的风暴！向灵耳响起，欢欣鼓舞！又是我们的一天了！麾！又一个黎明出现了！花岗岩大门轰隆隆地响着，福玻斯的车轮嘎嘎作响，碰撞着——多么铿锵的声音宣告着太阳的升起！鼓声清脆，眼花缭乱，耳目一新！离开！我们的精灵统治结束了。爬进华丽的圣杯，安静地休息，沉睡，或者在岩石下，或者在裂缝下；如果你听到它，你就是聋子。

@@U02210@@
生命的脉搏现在带着新鲜的活力在我体内跳动，准备好迎接黎明的空灵的一天。大地，伟大的大地，你在黑夜里忠于我，现在你也重新复活，已经给我注入了伟大的愿望，激起了我强大的决心：奋斗并永远奋斗到存在的顶峰。黎明的第一缕微光中，世界已被解锁；树林生机勃勃，回响着一千种声音；高低不一的山谷都笼罩在薄雾之中，而天上的清光却降到了它们的深处。树枝从薄雾中苏醒
